hypothesis: Work maintains continuity even when multiple actors simultaneously attempt to modify it, with concurrency control preventing corruption
experiment_sequence: 1. Human A creates W1 (requirement) with owner=user-001, status=draft, version=1
2. Human A requests review with reviewerIds=["user-002", "user-003", "agent-001"] → three parallel reviewers
3. W1 enters in_review status, version becomes 2
4. Launch three parallel executions of completeRequirementReview() from all three reviewers simultaneously
5. Only one execution should succeed, others should throw OCC concurrent modification error
6. The successful execution sets W1.status=review_completed, version becomes 3
7. Verify original owner (user-001) can still resume and approve (C14 passes)
8. Validate no Work corruption: all invariants preserved, no lost updates
success_criteria: OCC correctly blocks all but one concurrent update
No lost updates or corrupted state
reviewerIds authorization allows all three to attempt (they are assigned reviewers)
capability-registry concurrency detection also triggers for artifact-level protection
W1 identity never changes, owner remains user-001
artifact lineage correctly records all three attempts
no new code required beyond existing C18 reviewerIds change
